DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振り込みについて、ご不明な点を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you are unsure about regarding the bank transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書の会社名と、振込先の名義が違います。このまま送ってよいか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求元と振込先名義が異なり送金に不安があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: The company name on the invoice differs from the account holder's name for the transfer. I am worried about sending the money as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the invoice issuer's name differs from the recipient account holder's name, which makes you worried about the transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取先の情報が正しいか、請求元に確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need to check with the issuer of the invoice whether the recipient information is correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 請求書に書かれた番号だけでなく、前から知っている連絡先で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 請求書だけでなく以前から知る連絡先を使って確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to check using contact details I have known since before, rather than relying only on the number printed on the invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check using contact details you already knew, rather than relying only on the invoice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その確認を済ませるまで、振り込みを進めないというご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you prefer not to proceed with the transfer until you have completed that check?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうです。口座番号の最後の数字も読みづらいので、正しい情報を送り直してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送金を進めず読めない口座末尾を正しい情報で送り直してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The final digit of the account number is also hard to read, so I will ask them to send the correct information again.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not proceed with the transfer and will ask them to resend the correct information because the end of the account number is unreadable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報が明確になってから、振込方法についてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once the necessary information is clear, please consult us about how to make the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 費用も先に知りたいですが、方法によって違うのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 振込方法によって費用が異なるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would also like to know the cost beforehand. Does it vary depending on the method?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the cost differs depending on the transfer method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 振込方法などに応じて確認が必要です。実際の条件で担当者に照会してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: That needs to be checked according to the transfer method and other details. Please ask the staff member about the actual conditions that apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は送金せず、名義と番号を確かめてから、方法と費用を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は送らず名義と番号の確認後に方法と費用を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not send the money today. After checking the account holder's name and number, I will ask about the method and cost.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not send the money today and will ask about the method and cost after checking the account holder's name and number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認してから進めることを承りました。請求書をお忘れにならないようお持ちください。またご相談をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. You will check before proceeding. Please remember to take your invoice with you. We look forward to helping you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何名様分の乗車を予定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many people are you planning to buy tickets for?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と妹の二人です。妹は別の駅から来るので、二人分をここで買えるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 妹と二人で乗るが乗車駅が異なりまとめて購入できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two: my younger sister and me. She will travel from a different station, so I would like to know whether I can buy both tickets here.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you and your younger sister will travel from different boarding stations, and ask whether you can buy the tickets together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人の乗車区間と予定日を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check each person's travel route and planned date separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日付は同じですが、妹が乗る駅はまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ日付で妹の乗車駅はまだ聞いていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The date is the same, but I have not asked which station my sister will board at yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will travel on the same date, but have not asked your younger sister's boarding station yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗車駅がわかると、購入できるものと受け取り方を確認しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once we know the boarding station, it will be easier to check which tickets you can buy and how to collect them.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に妹に駅名を聞きます。私の切符だけ買う場合と、まとめて買う場合を比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅名を確認し一人分とまとめ買いの方法を比べたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my sister for the station name first. I would like to compare buying just my own ticket with buying both together.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the station name and compare buying one ticket with buying both together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受け渡しも含めて考えましょう。妹さんとは乗る前に会う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's consider how you will get the tickets to each other as well. Are you planning to meet your sister before boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗る前には会えません。妹が自分で受け取れる方法があるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗車前に妹と会えず妹自身が受け取れる方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We cannot meet before boarding. I would also like to ask whether there is a way for her to collect her ticket herself.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot meet your younger sister before boarding, and ask about a way for her to collect her own ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 方法によって条件が異なるため、区間が決まってから担当者に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The conditions vary depending on the method, so please check with the staff member once you have decided on the routes.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅名を確認してから、受け取り方を決めて購入します。今日は条件を整理できれば十分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車駅と受取方法を整理してから買い今日は相談までにすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: After checking the station name, I will decide how to collect the tickets and buy them. It is enough just to clarify the conditions today.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy after clarifying the boarding stations and collection method, and will only ask for advice today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご家族の区間と受け取り方がそろいましたら、改めてご相談ください。お二人での旅を楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please speak to us again once you have your family member's route and collection method ready. Enjoy your trip together.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展望施設の利用前に確認したいことはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check before using the observation facility?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は上へ行きたいのですが、友人は高い場所が苦手です。別々に待てるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 高所が苦手な友人と別々に待てるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to go up, but my friend is uncomfortable with heights. I would like to discuss whether we can wait separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss whether you and your friend, who is uncomfortable with heights, can wait separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこで待てるかは利用条件と併せて確認しましょう。友人の方は今ご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check where your friend can wait along with the conditions for using the facility. Is your friend with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここにいます。無理に誘わず、本人が待ちたい場所を先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無理に誘わず同行者の希望する待機場所を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here. I will not pressure my friend to come along; I will first ask where they would like to wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will not pressure your companion and will ask where they would like to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合流する方法も決めておくと安心ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would also be reassuring to decide how you will meet up again.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 戻る場所が上る場所と同じか、案内図で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 戻る場所が上る場所と同じか図で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can we check on the guide map whether the place I return to is the same as the place I go up from?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check on the map whether you will return to the same place you go up from. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この学習用の図で経路を説明します。矢印を逆にたどるだけとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain the route using this training map. It is not necessarily just a matter of following the arrows backward.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出口側の矢印も見るんですね。急いで歩かないよう、段差の表示も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出口方向と段差の表示を見て急がず進むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should look at the arrows toward the exit as well. I will also check the signs for changes in floor level so that I do not rush along.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the direction of the exit and signs for changes in floor level, and proceed without rushing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 足元の表示を確認し、立ち止まる際は通路を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the signs around your feet, and leave the walkway clear when you stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 経路と待機場所を確認して、戻ったら電話で連絡することにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 経路と待機場所を確認し帰ったら電話する計画を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: After checking the route and waiting place, I will arrange to call my friend when I return.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to check the route and waiting place, then call when you return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご友人と合流方法を共有してからお進みください。どうぞご自分のペースで景色をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please share the plan for meeting up with your friend before proceeding. Enjoy the view at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 店内の案内図で、行き先をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a destination on the store directory map?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 取り置いてもらった品を受け取りに戻りたいのですが、店の入口を見失いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 取り置き商品を受け取りたいが入口を見失ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go back to collect an item being held for me, but I have lost track of the shop entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to collect an item being held for you but have lost track of the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店名や受取案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the shop name or collection instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。店名はわかりますが、受取口という表示は覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店名のある紙は持つが受取口の表示を覚えていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the paper. I know the shop name, but I do not remember seeing a sign for a collection counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have a paper with the shop name but do not remember the collection counter sign. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 店の場所と受取口の場所は別に確認しましょう。どの階から移動してきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the shop location and collection counter location separately. Which floor did you come from?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上の階から降りてきました。買い物を続ける前に、戻り方をメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上階から来て買い物続行前に戻り方を記録したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I came down from the floor above. Before I continue shopping, I would like to note down how to get back.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you came from the floor above and want to note down how to return before continuing your shopping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図に今いる位置を示します。まず店舗の表示と紙の店名を照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will show your current location on the map. First, compare the shop label with the shop name on your paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ名前の表示を見つけました。受け取りは、その店のスタッフに紙を見せて聞けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ店名の表示を見つけ店舗スタッフに紙で相談する方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I found a label with the same name. For collection, should I show this paper to the shop staff and ask them?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you found a sign with the same shop name, and ask whether you should show the paper to the shop staff for help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取方法は店舗の担当者にご確認ください。案内図から受取条件まで判断することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the collection procedure with the staff responsible at the shop. We cannot determine collection conditions from the directory map.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 店名と階をメモしました。先に店で受取口を確かめてから、ほかの買い物に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 店名と階を記録し先に受取口を確認してから買い物を続けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have noted down the shop name and floor. I will check the collection counter at the shop first, then return to my other shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have recorded the shop name and floor and will check the collection counter before continuing to shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 店舗までの経路は図でご確認いただけましたね。お取り置きの紙をお忘れにならないよう、お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have been able to check the route to the shop on the map. Please remember your reservation paper, and enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約票を二枚お持ちですが、確認をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two appointment slips. Would you like us to check them?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二枚の予約票を確認したいです。日付が違うので、今の予約がどちらか自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の票で日付が異なり有効な予約が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to check these two appointment slips. They have different dates, so I am not sure which is my current appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your two slips show different dates and you do not know which appointment is valid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 古い票も含まれているかもしれません。予約情報を担当者に確認してもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: One may be an old slip. Let's have the staff member check your appointment information.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この新しそうな紙の日付に、会社の予定が重なっています。変更できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新しいと思う予約日に勤務予定が重なり変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have work scheduled on the date on this paper, which looks newer. I would like to ask whether I can change the appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that work is scheduled on the appointment date you think is newer, and ask about changing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず有効な予約日時を確認します。変更を希望される事情も担当者へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, we will check the valid appointment date and time. Please also tell the staff member why you would like to change it.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 仕事の予定と重なっていますが、受診を遅らせてよいかは自分ではわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事と重なるが受診を遅らせてよいか判断できないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It conflicts with my work schedule, but I cannot judge for myself whether it is all right to delay the medical consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the appointment conflicts with work, but you cannot judge whether it is all right to delay being seen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受診時期については医療スタッフに相談してください。単に空いた日に動かすとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consult the medical staff about when you should be seen. You may not simply be able to move it to a free day.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二枚とも見せて、有効な日付を確認してから希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両票を示して有効日付を確認した後に希望を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show both slips, check the valid date, and then explain what I would like.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will show both slips, check the valid date, and then explain your preference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順番で担当者に相談しましょう。今の予約はまだ変更したつもりで扱わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's speak to the staff member in that order. Please do not treat your current appointment as though it has already been changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認結果をメモして、変更が決まったら古い票と分けて保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認結果を記録し変更確定後は古い票と分けて保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note down the result of the check. Once a change is confirmed, I will keep the new slip separate from the old one.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the result of the check and keep the new slip separate from the old one once a change is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者へご案内します。二枚の票をそろえてお持ちください。私は受付へ戻りますので、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the staff member. Please take both slips together. I will return to reception now, so please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の受付方法についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about how to arrange a consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 出来事を順番に話すのが苦手なので、先に紙を見てもらえるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 順序立てて話すのが苦手で書面を先に見てもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I find it difficult to explain events in order, so I would like to know whether someone could read my paper first.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you find it difficult to speak in sequence, and ask whether your written account can be read first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談内容の概要を整理したメモがあれば、担当者に見てもらう希望を伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you have a memo outlining your concerns, we can tell the staff member that you would like them to read it.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日付と出来事を箇条書きにしました。人の名前はここで声に出さないほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日付と出来事のメモを示し名前を声に出すべきか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have listed the dates and events in bullet points. Would it be better not to say people's names aloud here?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your notes of the dates and events, and ask whether you should say people's names aloud. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周囲への配慮が必要な内容は、相談場所も担当者に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: For matters that require consideration of the people around you, let's also ask the staff member where the consultation can take place.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人の名前が含まれるので、別の場所で紙を見せたいです。予約の要否も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 個人名を含む紙を別の場所で示したく予約の要否も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The paper contains people's names, so I would like to show it somewhere else. Please also tell me whether an appointment is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to show a paper containing people's names somewhere else, and ask whether an appointment is required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付の方法を担当者へ照会します。今日は概要の確認まででもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the staff member about the reception procedure. Would it be all right just to check the outline today?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず受付の方法を知りたいです。詳しい話は、落ち着いて話せる準備をしてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まず受付方法を確認し詳しい話は準備後にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: First, I would like to find out how to arrange a consultation. I will discuss the details after preparing so that I can speak calmly.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will first check the reception procedure and discuss the details after preparing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、来訪方法と準備する情報を確認する相談として引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will hand this over as an inquiry about how to attend and what information to prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモを手元に残して、案内された方法で相談する日時を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモを保持して案内された方法で相談日時を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the memo with me and use the method you explain to arrange a date and time for the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the memo and arrange a consultation date and time using the method explained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付担当へおつなぎします。メモを取り違えないようお持ちください。私はご案内を終えますので、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the reception staff. Please keep your memo with you and avoid mixing it up with another paper. That concludes my assistance, so please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベルトの長さを確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check the belt's length?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長さを確かめたいです。サイズの数字は見ましたが、服の上から使うので合うか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: サイズ数字は見たが服の上に使うため適合が不安と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to check the length. I have looked at the size numbers, but I will wear it over my clothes, so I am worried about whether it will fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked the size numbers but are worried about the fit because you will wear it over your clothes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 調整できる範囲を表示で確認しましょう。試すための見本も用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the adjustable range on the label. I will also bring a sample for you to try.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普段より厚い服を着ています。この上から試してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 厚い服の上から見本を試せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am wearing thicker clothes than usual. May I try it over these?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may try the sample over your thick clothes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この見本でお試しください。無理に引いて伸ばさず、調整部分を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please try this sample. Check the adjustment section without pulling hard to stretch it.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 穴を一つ変えると楽になります。切って短くするタイプではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 穴で調整でき切って短くする製品ではないか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Moving it by one hole makes it more comfortable. It is not the type you cut shorter, is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the product adjusts through its holes rather than being cut shorter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品の説明を一緒に確認しましょう。購入後の対応についてもお尋ねになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the product instructions together. Would you also like to ask about what can be done after purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 合わなかった場合の扱いと、付属品をなくした場合の条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合わない場合と付属品紛失時の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to ask what happens if it does not fit, and what conditions apply if I lose an accessory.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what happens if it does not fit or if you lose an accessory. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件は担当者がご説明しますので、購入前に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain the conditions, so please check before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 使い方と条件を聞いてから決めます。サイズの数字だけで判断しなくてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数字だけでなく使用方法と条件を聞いて購入を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will decide after hearing how to use it and the conditions. I am glad I did not judge by the size numbers alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide whether to buy after hearing how to use it and the conditions, rather than relying on the numbers alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見本をお戻しいただきありがとうございます。ご納得いただけるまで確認して、お気に入りの一本をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for returning the sample. Please check until you are satisfied, and choose a belt you like.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 量り売りの商品で、表示を確認したいものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there a label you would like to check for any of the products sold by weight?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この値段は一袋の値段ですか。それとも重さで計算するのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 値段が袋単位か重さによる計算か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this the price for one bag, or is it calculated by weight?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the price is per bag or calculated by weight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用の札では重さの単位を示しています。希望する量を伺ってから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This training price tag indicates a unit of weight. We will check after asking how much you would like.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人で食べる分を考えています。原材料と保存方法の紙もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人分を考えて原材料と保存方法を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am thinking of enough for two people. Is there also a sheet listing the ingredients and storage instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are considering enough for two people and want to check the ingredients and storage instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品ごとの表示をご確認いただけます。どの部分を読みたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the labeling for each product. Which part would you like to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 味付けに使う材料と、買ったあと冷蔵するかどうかを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 味付けの材料と購入後の冷蔵要否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to know the ingredients used for seasoning and whether it needs refrigeration after purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the seasoning ingredients and whether refrigeration is needed after purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この欄が味付けの材料です。保存方法は別の欄で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This section lists the seasoning ingredients. Let's check the storage instructions in a separate section.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 違う欄なんですね。持ち帰る容器にも表示を付けてもらえるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保存欄を理解し容器にも表示を添えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: They are in different sections, then. I would like to ask whether you can also attach the labeling to the container I take home.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the storage instructions are in a separate section, and ask whether labeling can also be provided with the container. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示の渡し方は担当者に確認します。量を決める前に、内容も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask the staff member how the labeling can be provided. Please check the contents as well before deciding on the amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を読んでから量を決めます。家で見直せるものを受け取って持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を読んでから量を選び家で見返せる情報を受け取ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will decide on the amount after reading the label. I will take home information I can refer to again at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose the amount after reading the label and obtain information you can review at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 量と表示の確認から進めます。お帰りまで保存方法にご注意いただき、お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will start by checking the amount and labeling. Please pay attention to the storage instructions until you get home, and enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 学校からの書類をご覧になっているのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at some documents from the school, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもがこれを持って帰りました。証明書の名前が略されていて、何を出すのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもの依頼書で証明書名が略され必要書類が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child brought this home. The certificate's name is abbreviated, so I do not know what to submit.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the certificate name on your child's request is abbreviated, leaving you unsure which document is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 依頼書に提出先や担当者の記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the request state where to submit it or who is responsible?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学校の事務室とあります。ただ、家族全員のものか子どもだけのものかも読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先は学校事務室だが家族全員か子だけか読めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says the school office. However, I also cannot tell whether it needs to cover the whole family or just my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the recipient is the school office, but you cannot tell whether the document must cover the whole family or only your child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象者と記載事項は提出先に確認しましょう。窓口だけでは依頼の意図を断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check with the recipient who it should cover and what information it must contain. This counter alone cannot determine what the request intends.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 学校に聞くために、確認する項目を一緒に整理してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 学校へ聞く項目を一緒にまとめるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you help me organize the questions I should ask the school?
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for help organizing the questions to ask the school. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 正式な名称、対象者、必要な記載事項を確認するようメモしておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's note down that you should check the official name, the people it must cover, and the required information.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三つを聞きます。確認後に来るとき、本人以外が申請できるかも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三項目を確認し本人以外の申請可否も相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask those three things. When I come back after checking, I would also like to ask whether someone other than the person concerned can apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the three points and also want to ask whether someone other than the person concerned may apply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申請者についての条件は、書類の種類が決まってから担当者に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the conditions regarding applicants with the staff member once the document type is clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に学校へ連絡して、書類が決まったら申請できる人と持ち物を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 学校に書類を確認してから申請者と持ち物を尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact the school first. Once the document is identified, I will ask who can apply and what to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the document with the school before asking who can apply and what to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 依頼書と確認したメモを一緒にお持ちください。学校への確認後、改めて窓口でお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the request together with your notes of what you confirmed. We look forward to seeing you at the counter again after you check with the school.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知の内容を確認するためにお越しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to check the contents of a notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 封筒が二つ届きました。同じ税の通知だと思いましたが、名前が少し違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二通の封筒を同じ税の通知と思ったが名称が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two envelopes arrived. I thought they were notices about the same tax, but the titles are slightly different.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that two envelopes arrived and you thought they concerned the same tax, but their titles differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発行元をそれぞれ確認しましょう。通知の中身をお見せいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check who issued each one. Could you show me the contents of the notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらは税の名前があり、もう一つには手続きの案内と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一方は税名もう一方は手続き案内と表示されると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one has a tax name, while the other says it is guidance on a procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that one lists a tax name while the other is labeled as procedural guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ内容とは限りません。担当窓口もそれぞれ確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: They do not necessarily have the same contents. You also need to check the responsible counter for each one.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 期限のような日付が二つあるので、どちらを気にすればよいか混乱しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限らしい二つの日付でどちらを重視するか迷うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two dates that look like deadlines, so I am confused about which one I should focus on.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you are unsure which of two apparent deadline dates to focus on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日付が何を示すかも、各通知の担当者へ確認しましょう。私が推測して一つにまとめることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's also check what each date means with the person responsible for that notice. I cannot make assumptions and combine them into one matter.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通知ごとに聞くんですね。問い合わせるときに番号を読み上げてよい場所も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 文書ごとに確認すると理解し番号を話せる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should ask about each notice separately. I would also like to check where I can read out the numbers when making my inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that each document needs to be checked separately, and ask where you can say the numbers aloud. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 個人情報が含まれる場合は周囲に配慮して提示してください。担当者へご希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: If personal information is included, please show it with consideration for those around you. I will pass your preference on to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封筒と通知を組にして、発行元と日付の意味を別々に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒と中身を対にして発行元と日付の意味を別々に聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pair each envelope with its notice and ask separately about the issuer and what the date means.
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will pair the envelopes with their contents and ask separately about their issuers and the meanings of the dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二組に分けてお持ちください。該当する担当窓口を確認してご案内しますので、私はここで失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-040-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep them in two separate sets. We will identify the appropriate counters and direct you there. I will leave you here, so please excuse me.
